title: The  race to build AGI: who's winning in 2026?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The race to build AGI is heating up — and one company is leading the pack.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: AGI could change everything from healthcare to jobs in the next few years.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: AGI is artificial general intelligence — a machine that thinks like a human.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Google’s new neural architecture can learn tasks in minutes, not months.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects billions — from doctors to drivers to data analysts.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? AGI is closer than you think, and it’s not just sci-fi.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Who do you think will win the AGI race — and why?
